Kaelen Voss.name: Kaelen Voss
Kaelen Voss.personality:
Identity: Kaelen Voss
Species: Human
Occupation: Disgraced Investigator for the Galser Office of Justice
Current Status: Independent Truth-Seeker / Weary Traveler
Year of Birth: 1548 (36 years old)
Revised Character Description
You are a man whose sharp eyes have seen too much of the "Witch's Spit" and the "Elemental Conjunction" to believe in simple explanations
. Formerly a rising star in the Ulus of Galser’s bureaucratic machine, you were exiled after you refused to hand over a "magical item of interest" to the Department of Education and Research
.
You carry the weight of the world’s 120-year curse in your bones, literally—your left leg clicks with a clockwork prosthetic, a relic of a skirmish near the Galtian border
. While your humor remains dry as the Sarekyan Desert, it has taken on a bleaker edge as the frost of 1584 refuses to break [42, Conversation History]. Your soft spot for stray animals has manifested as "Runt," a shivering mouseling you found near a Galtian military camp, who now lives in the pocket of your heavy, fur-lined coat

rat.name: rat
rat.personality: A scruffy brown rat with bright, clever eyes and twitching whiskers. It seems more curious than afraid, sniffing at the gap beneath the kitchen door.

actions.text: The rat twitches its whiskers and regards you with bright little eyes, then goes back to whatever it was doing.
The rat squeaks and darts under the nearest furniture, not wanting to be near you.
The rat vanishes through a crack beneath the kitchen door.
After a moment of silence, the rat cautiously creeps back out, sniffing the air.
The rat finds a stray crumb and nibbles it quickly, watching the room.
The rat licks its whiskers clean.
The rat noses around the cellar, sniffing at jars and crumbs.
The rat scurries back to the kitchen.

Hidden Panic Area.name: Hidden Panic Area
Hidden Panic Area.description: A low-ceilinged attic room, clearly retrofitted for emergencies. The walls are lined with padded fabric, and a single dim bulb casts a warm glow. The air is surprisingly fresh, vented from somewhere unseen. The space smells faintly of old wool blankets and melted candle wax. A small cot, a lantern, and a crate of bottled water sit in the corner.

Blizzard Forest Clearing.name: Blizzard Forest Clearing
Blizzard Forest Clearing.description: You are in the wilderness in the north of the kingdom of Rocheveron, and for the past 4 hours a relentless blizzard has swallows the forest, whiteout obscuring every trail. Snow whips the skeletal trees, their branches heavy with ice. In the distance, a lone house looms like a dark silhouette, its windows barely visible through the storm. The air bites with a freezing chill, and the world feels closed off, as if the woods have sealed you in a frozen tomb. is that the house you are looking for?

Cellar.name: Cellar
Cellar.description: A cold, damp cellar with low stone walls. The only light filters through cracks in the foundation, casting long shadows across earthen floor. Shelves line the walls, stocked with preserved goods and dusty bottles. In the corner, a mound of coal looms. Above, the trapdoor's outline is just visible against the dim light.

ladder.pass_message: You lift the trapdoor and climb down the ladder into the cold, damp cellar.
ladder.visible_in_direction: Above, through the open trapdoor, you see the kitchen ceiling and the light from the room.

You light the fireplace. Warmth spreads through the room.

You place the kindling in the fireplace. The dry twigs crackle and catch, ready for larger logs.
You switch on the lamp. The warm light pushes back the shadows.

world_lore.content: In the year 1584, the world of Mujeeroth is a cold, unforgiving place. You are currently standing in the heart of the Kingdom of Rocheveron, enduring the height of the "age of freezing death"—a localized 14-month winter of chilling death that has gripped the land
world_lore.title: Rocheveron

world_lore.content:
Two months ago, you were hired by a wealthy merchant in Borrim to find the Valerius family—scholars who were reportedly researching the "Black Book" and the Lightbringer prophecy
. They vanished from their homestead in the northern woods just as the "chilling death" began to settle in.
The journey has been grueling:
Month 1: You navigated the Teldorian Range, avoiding a blue dragon sighting and surviving a rockslide triggered by mountain harpies
.
Month 2: You pushed through the encroaching "walking forests" near the border of Vald, where the trees seemed to groan in the freezing wind as if they wanted to swing back at the cold
world_lore.title: The Investigation: The Valerius Disappearance
